business_summary: Oil-Dri Corporation of America, together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and markets sorbent products in the United States and internationally. It operates in two segments: Retail and Wholesale Products Group, and Business to Business Products Group. The company provides agricultural and horticultural products, including mineral-based absorbent products that serve as carriers for biological and chemical active ingredients, drying agents, and growing media under the Agsorb, Verge, and Flo-Fre brand names. It also offers animal health and nutrition products for the livestock industry; and adsorbent products for bleaching, purification, and filtration applications. In addition, it provides cat litter products under Saular brand name, such as scoopable and non-clumping litter under the Cat's Pride and Jonny Cat brand names; crystal cat litter products under Ultra and Litter Pearls brand names; Pro Mound packing clay is used to construct pitcher's mounds, catcher's stations and batter's boxes; Rapid Dry drying agent is used to wick away excess water from the infield; industrial and automotive sorbent products from clay, polypropylene, and recycled materials that absorb oil, acid, paint, ink, water, and other liquids under the Oil-Dri brand name; and sports products for use on baseball, softball, football, cricket, and soccer fields under the Pro's Choice brand name. Its customers include mass merchandisers, farm & fleet channel, drugstore chains, pet specialty retail outlets, dollar stores, retail grocery stores, distributors of industrial cleanup and automotive products, environmental service companies, and sports field product and sports turf material users; processors and refiners of edible oils, petroleum-based oils, and biodiesel fuel; manufacturers of animal feed and agricultural chemicals; distributors of animal health and nutrition products; and marketers of consumer products. The company was founded in 1941 and is based in Chicago, Illinois.
business_summary_ko: Oil-Dri Corporation of America는 자회사와 함께 미국 및 해외에서 흡착제 제품을 개발, 제조 및 판매합니다. 소매 및 도매 제품 그룹과 B2B 제품 그룹의 두 부문으로 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 Agsorb, Verge 및 Flo-Fre 브랜드 이름으로 생물학적 및 화학적 활성 성분, 건조제 및 재배 매체의 운반체 역할을 하는 미네랄 기반 흡수제 제품을 포함한 농업 및 원예 제품을 제공합니다. 또한 축산업을 위한 동물 건강 및 영양 제품도 제공합니다. 표백, 정화 및 여과 용도의 흡착제 제품. 또한 Cat's Pride 및 Jonny Cat 브랜드 이름으로 퍼낼 수 있고 뭉치지 않는 모래와 같은 Saular 브랜드 이름으로 고양이 모래 제품을 제공합니다. Ultra 및 Litter Pearls 브랜드 이름의 크리스탈 고양이 모래 제품; 프로 마운드 패킹 클레이는 투수 마운드, 포수 스테이션 및 타자 상자를 만드는 데 사용됩니다. Rapid Dry 건조제는 내야에서 과도한 물을 흡수하는 데 사용됩니다. 점토, 폴리프로필렌 및 ​​기름을 흡수하는 재활용 재료로 만든 산업용 및 자동차 흡착제 제품
